cullinggame.cursed_domain.rule.leave_by_: A player may leave the game by spending 100 points to invite a substitute into their colony.
cullinggame.cursed_domain.rule.merger_au: Authority to activate the Great Merger passes to Ryomen Sukuna.

cullinggame.cursed_domain.rule.point_tra: Players may transfer any number of points to one another.

cullinggame.cursed_domain.rule.scoring: Players score points by ending the lives of other players.
cullinggame.cursed_domain.rule.stagnatio: If a player's score remains the same for 19 days, they will be subject to cursed technique removal.
cullinggame.cursed_domain.rule.technique: Any player who breaks the previous rule will be subject to cursed technique removal.

cullinggame.cursed_domain.start.4: I once tried to make something greater with my own hands. It never surpassed me. So: chaos. Show me the golden age of jujutsu.

letter.cursed_domain.applicant: (You are now an applicant to Jujutsu High. Use the letter to feel which way it leans; sneak and use it to read it again.)
letter.cursed_domain.body:
To the one who can now read this,
If these words have appeared to you, then you have started to see what most people never will. What hurt you was no accident. It was a curse: a thing born from the fear and spite people leave behind.
You now carry cursed energy of your own. Untrained, it will draw them to you. Trained, it can drive them back.
There is a school hidden in the mountains where sorcerers are made. Hold this letter out and it will lean the way you need to go. The road is not marked, and it is not meant to be.
Come prepared to answer one question: why do you want to be here?
letter.cursed_domain.title: Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School
npc.cursed_domain.charles_bernard.dodge: I saw that coming. G-Warstaff shows me the future!
npc.cursed_domain.charles_bernard.yield: Fine... this chapter's over. Take my points.
npc.cursed_domain.fumihiko_takaba.immune: Ow! ...Just kidding, I'm fine. Comedians don't die mid-bit!
Is this a tsukkomi? Your timing needs work!
That would've hurt if it were funny!
npc.cursed_domain.fumihiko_takaba.joke.1: Why did the curse cross the barrier? It couldn't! Rule 12 isn't in yet!
npc.cursed_domain.fumihiko_takaba.joke.2: I joined the Culling Game for the exposure. Turns out it's mostly cursed energy exposure!
npc.cursed_domain.fumihiko_takaba.joke.3: Five points for a sorcerer, one for a comedian? Even the game master's a critic!
npc.cursed_domain.fumihiko_takaba.joke.4: My technique? It's called Comedian. Yes, that's the whole bit.
npc.cursed_domain.fumihiko_takaba.joke.5: If you laughed, you lost. If you didn't laugh, I lost. Either way, nobody dies!
npc.cursed_domain.generic.yield: Okay, okay! Take my points, just let me go!
npc.cursed_domain.hagane_daido.yield: Your blade is honest. I yield.
npc.cursed_domain.hajime_kashimo.amber: Mythical Beast Amber! I'll burn out with you, then!
npc.cursed_domain.hajime_kashimo.yield: Ha! That was fun. My hundred points are yours. Now, where's Sukuna?
npc.cursed_domain.hana_kurusu.already: The Prison Realm is already open.
npc.cursed_domain.hana_kurusu.greet: I am the Angel. My technique extinguishes all techniques. If you bring me the Prison Realm, I can open it.
npc.cursed_domain.hana_kurusu.unseal: Jacob's Ladder! The seal on the back gate is broken. He is free.
npc.cursed_domain.hana_kurusu.vessel: You carry the Fallen One. I will not help him... but I will help you, if you bring me the Prison Realm.
npc.cursed_domain.hana_kurusu.yield: Stop this. If it is points you want, take them.
npc.cursed_domain.hanami.roots: You will return to the earth.
npc.cursed_domain.hanyu.yield: Don't kill me! The points are yours!
npc.cursed_domain.hiromi_higuruma.confis: Judgeman finds you guilty. Your cursed technique is confiscated.
npc.cursed_domain.hiromi_higuruma.death_: Guilty. The death penalty. The Executioner's Sword is in my hands.
npc.cursed_domain.hiromi_higuruma.yield: Enough. I knew who the real culprit was. I'll spend my points on your rule: points can be transferred.
npc.cursed_domain.hiromi_higuruma.yield_: Enough. I'm out. Take what I have left.
npc.cursed_domain.iori_hazenoki.yield: Fine! Have them, just stop haggling!
npc.cursed_domain.jogo.domain: Domain Expansion: Coffin of the Iron Mountain!
npc.cursed_domain.naoya.projection: Too slow. Twenty-four frames a second.
npc.cursed_domain.reggie_star.receipt: Contract Repossession! Everything I ever paid for comes back.
npc.cursed_domain.reggie_star.yield: You win. A deal's a deal; take the points.
npc.cursed_domain.remi.yield: Waaah, okay, I give up! Take them!
npc.cursed_domain.rokujushi_miyo.again: One lesson a day. Go use what you learned!
Haha! A good push, but sumo is about the feet!
npc.cursed_domain.rokujushi_miyo.lesson: Let go of what holds you back. Feel everything at once... There! That's the zone.
npc.cursed_domain.ryu_ishigori.yield: What a dessert! I'm stuffed. The points are yours.
npc.cursed_domain.takako_uro.yield: Hmph. You're stronger than you look. Take them.

shibuya.cursed_domain.begin.2: From inside, a demand: bring Satoru Gojo here.

shibuya.cursed_domain.kenjaku.absorb: You've done enough, Mahito. Your technique is mine now.
shibuya.cursed_domain.kenjaku.arrive: It's been a while. With Gojo sealed, nothing stands between me and what comes next.
shibuya.cursed_domain.kenjaku.escape: This was fun, but I have somewhere to be. Keep the box; you won't be able to open it. Here, a parting gift.
shibuya.cursed_domain.mahito: Mahito comes out to play. Bodies twist where he touches them.
shibuya.cursed_domain.prison_realm: Deep under the station, the strongest sorcerer is sealed away. And the one who planned it is here.
